messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline is FDA-approved to treat six conditions in adults:
Major depressive disorder (MDD), the clinical term for depression.
Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), where unwanted thoughts drive repeated behaviors.
Panic disorder, which causes sudden attacks of intense fear along with physical symptoms.
Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), which can follow a frightening or traumatic event.
Social anxiety disorder (SAD), also called social phobia.
Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD), a severe form of premenstrual symptoms.
In children and teenagers, sertraline is approved only for OCD, from age 6 upward.
Sertraline's safety and effectiveness have not been established in children under 6 years of age.
Sertraline's safety and effectiveness have not been established in children and teenagers for any condition other than OCD.
Not every sertraline product is approved for all six conditions:
Sertraline tablets and oral solution are approved for all of them.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has approved product form for all six conditions", "tablets and oral solution"]

The relation 'has approved product form for all six conditions' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's specific product form is approved for all six medical conditions it is indicated for.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has multiple brands and forms': The subject drug is available in multiple brands and forms as specified by the object entity.
B. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
C. 'approved for heart failure': The subject drug is approved for the treatment of heart failure.
D. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
E. 'approved for same uses as': The subject drug is approved for the same medical indications or therapeutic uses as the object drug.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
